scope: Keep the retained target simulator while replacing its inert NGE expertise controls with the armor rating, typed resistances, and defense skill modifiers consumed by the authoritative Publish 14.1 combat route.

findings: Publish 14.1 primary hit resolution uses the attacking weapon profile's ranged_defense or melee_defense statistic on the defender rather than an NGE expertise defense family.
The retained simulator's default creature weapon uses unarmed_passive_defense for its secondary defense result, matching the current authenticated PRE-CU weapon profile.
Publish 14.1 creature armor is an armor rating from 0 through 3 plus raw typed resistances from -1 through 200, where -1 is vulnerability and values over 100 mark special protection.

The retired expertise dodge, parry, block-chance, glancing-blow, evasion, and innate-protection controls were not read by the authoritative PRE-CU route and therefore could not configure the target being tested.
